english.meaning: a dismissive retort, as in 你老公個朵; the meaning is guessed from the tone
english.note: This meaning is less certain: it was read from a few recorded conversations.

exampleSentences.english: Never mind. I’ll use your husband’s name. Do you know roughly when this will be on?
exampleSentences.traditional: 不過唔緊要喇。噠你老公個朵。幾時度有得睇唧噉哩啲，知唔知大概？
